### Screenshots

Refreshes the GNOME Shell extension captures rendered on [the extension's page](https://mpm.run/gnome-shell/).

Every image is a real screenshot: a headless `$shell_version` session loads the extension, opens the indicator menu and photographs it through the shell's own screenshot service. The package data comes from `docs/outdated-sample.json` so the menu is identical from one run to the next, and the panel clock is hidden for the same reason.

This PR is auto-generated by `.github/workflows/docs-screenshots.yaml` whenever the extension sources or that payload change on `main`. Review it as a picture: GitHub's image diff is the point, and anything unexpected in the frame (a missing icon, a fallback font, an error message where the package list should be) is the finding.
